synthesis.paragraph: Three papers today carry the tag "Traffic control and management," evaluating the impact of a Japanese road bypass on travel times, comparing link- and path-based congestion incentives, and reviewing the transit readiness of autonomous shuttles. Another three papers are grouped under "Urban Transport and Accessibility," analyzing elderly bikeshare trajectory patterns, assessing public perceptions of disability-friendly urban inclusivity in China, and modeling the equity impacts of integrating e-bikes with public transit in São Paulo. The tag "spatial analysis" also covers three of today's papers, which include the Chinese disability-friendly inclusivity study, a deep learning framework mapping visual preferences from geotagged images, and a Python-based estimation of urban surface albedo from street-view colors. Outside these groups, one paper conceptualizes child mobility activism as ludic spaces that prefigure children's right to the mobile city, another maps the geographic distribution of public-sector cardiologists and cardiovascular mortality across Greece, and a third proposes a housing quality assessment model for urban regeneration in Kadıköy, İstanbul.
